hooks.command: zsh -c 'd=${PWD:A}; while [[ "$d" != "/" && ! -f "$d/.codex/hooks/check-sot-drift.sh" ]]; do d=${d:h}; done; if [[ -f "$d/.codex/hooks/check-sot-drift.sh" ]]; then exec zsh "$d/.codex/hooks/check-sot-drift.sh"; else print -u2 -- "check-sot-drift.sh not found"; exit 1; fi'
hooks.commandWindows: pwsh -NoProfile -Command '$d = (Get-Location).Path; while ($true) { $script = Join-Path $d ".codex\hooks\check-sot-drift.ps1"; if (Test-Path -LiteralPath $script) { & $script; exit 0 }; $parent = Split-Path -Parent $d; if ([string]::IsNullOrEmpty($parent) -or $parent -eq $d) { Write-Error "check-sot-drift.ps1 not found"; exit 1 }; $d = $parent }'
